What this means for your business

People compare quickly. Search and AI systems also need accessible text and reliable sources. A page that could belong to any company has very little to contribute.

What to watch

  • Claims such as quality, innovation, and passion with no example.
  • Services named but never explained.
  • Old contact details or dead customer paths.
  • Mass-produced pages that add no local or practical value.

Do this next

  1. Replace the first generic paragraph with a direct answer.
  2. Show a real process, artifact, or approved result.
  3. Cite outside facts beside the claim.
  4. Delete or combine pages that do not earn their own existence.

When Little Fight fits

We turn the website into a useful source and connect it to the action the owner needs. If the existing site is already clear and healthy, we will not prescribe a rebuild.

insight.answer: A business website becomes easy to ignore when it is generic, stale, or impossible to use. The fix is clearer information and better proof, not a louder marketing headline.
